title: Malibu
lyrics: Going to Malibu, oh you're looking good too, you're going to Malibu Going down the street to Malibu I can meet you like a book in your eyes It shines above the night sky The heart's down, your heart's down, the top's down We're driving all night, baby Come on, come and come to Malibu Come on, come on, drive on down to Malibu All I'm waiting for you It's looking so good tonight Just seeing all the signs about you It's so special It's a tequila waste, a phase to do me more We can't ever dream of you putting chips on the table I see your heart there in front of me I don't wanna be down no more I wanna be here with you Come on down to Malibu Yeah, come on down to Malibu With me, you, everything you do Oh, oh, oh, oh You, oh, oh, oh I know, you know this is the thing We always wanna do it Malibu will teach you how to be a little preacher Watch you flip around and do a ninja Let me take your smile Let me drink a little wine And I'll have you mine down in Malibu Baby, I'm down in Malibu waiting for you Down in Malibu With you Oh, oh, oh, oh Spend a trip or day with me And drop it in apostrophe I'll be there for you No matter you think it's a apostrophe With apostrophe There's nobody here but you and me Down in Malibu I'm waiting for you Freestyle, bitch Come on down to Malibu With me We'll do whatever we see fit And we'll roll and we'll be The thing, the moment with no regret
